# Code of conduct

This handbook exists to help people learn to mod Songs of Syx. Everyone taking part in this repository, in issues, comments or anywhere else on it, is expected to keep it a place where that can happen.

## What we expect

- Be respectful and patient, especially with people who are new to modding.
- Keep discussion about the handbook and the game.
- When you point out a mistake, point at the evidence (the game file, the code, what happened in game), not at the person.
- Accept that a report may be closed if it can't be confirmed in the game's files.

## What isn't acceptable

- Harassment, insults or personal attacks.
- Discriminatory language or content of any kind.
- Sexual content, or violent threats.
- Publishing someone else's private information.
- Spam, advertising, or repeated off-topic posts.

## Reporting a problem

Use GitHub's **Report content** option on the comment or issue (the `...` menu in its top corner). This sends a private report to GitHub. The maintainer also moderates the repository directly and acts on anything that breaks this code of conduct.

## What happens next

The maintainer may edit, hide or delete comments, lock or close issues, and block anyone who breaks this code of conduct from the repository. More serious cases may also be reported to GitHub under its [Community Guidelines](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/github-terms/github-community-guidelines).
